那团黑影倏地一下溃散成无数细密的黑雾，彻底融化在四周的黑暗之中。

许默的右手不可抑制地颤抖，冰汗汇聚，顺着下巴滴入泥土。

他眼角剧烈地抽搐了两下，将战刃缓缓插回腰间的鞘中。

“快走。”

两人互相搀扶着，几乎是连滚带爬地撞向庇护所。

许默用尽全身最后的力气顶开大门。

两人重重地摔进屋内。

许默反手关门，沉重的门栓死死卡入凹槽。

黑暗笼罩。

壁炉里预留的火种被迅速引燃。

一团明艳的火焰轰然腾起，舔舐着干柴，将那些试图顺着门缝渗透进来的阴冷与战栗驱散殆尽。

方芸瘫坐在地，后背死死贴着门板，胸膛起伏。

火舌噼啪作响。

两人隔着壁炉静静地瘫坐着，谁也没有试图去打破这份劫后余生。

煎熬过后，方芸的身体终于渐渐放松，不再筛糠般发抖。

许默盯着火苗，突然冷笑。

“我们和那个死在蜘蛛巢里的倒霉蛋，根本没有任何区别。”

“典型的利令智昏。明明理智值已经见底，明明知道距离庇护所还有那么远的路程，但在看到那株紫阶植物的瞬间，脑子里剩下的竟然全都是贪婪……为了几块资源，差点把命全交代在野外。”

方芸心有余悸地蜷缩起双腿，将下巴轻轻搁在膝盖上，火光映照着她脸颊苍白。

“理智值跌破底线……原来是这种连灵魂都会被彻底抽干的恐惧感。”

屋内的紧绷终于被一点点卸下。

工作台旁的泥土里传来一阵悉悉索索的轻响。

那株被暴力塞进储物空间的曼德拉草被放了出来。

这诡异的小东西只有两个巴掌高，粗糙的肉质根茎犹如一双短小的人腿，正绕着许默沾满烂泥的鞋焦躁地打着转。

它的头顶顶着三片翠绿小叶。

许默一脚将这个企图抱着自己靴子啃咬的小怪物拨开，伸手调出数据面板，开始飞速清点今天的生死所得。

今天在林地外围疯狂砍伐，一共获取了32单位的木材，10单位石材。

加上储物箱里昨天剩下的31单位，总算凑够了一笔还算可观的资源。

明天必须把捕鸟的陷阱和鸟笼安排上。

他站起身，走到方芸身旁，隔着半个身位的距离席地而坐。

The black shadow suddenly disintegrated into countless fine black mist, completely melting into the surrounding darkness.

Xu Mo's right hand trembled uncontrollably, ice sweat gathered and dripped down his chin into the soil.

The corners of his eyes twitched violently twice, and he slowly inserted the war blade back into the sheath on his waist.

"Go quickly."

The two of them supported each other and almost rolled towards the shelter.

Xu Mo used his last strength to push open the door.

The two fell heavily into the house.

Xu Mo closed the door with his backhand, and the heavy bolt stuck tightly into the groove.

Darkness envelops.

The fire reserved in the fireplace was quickly ignited.

A bright flame burst into flames, licking the dry wood and driving away the coldness and trembling that tried to penetrate through the cracks in the door.

Fang Yun sat slumped on the ground, her back pressed tightly against the door panel, and her chest heaved.

The fire crackled.

The two sat quietly across the fireplace, neither of them trying to break this disaster.

After the ordeal, Fang Yun's body finally relaxed and no longer shivered like chaff.

Xu Mo stared at the flames and suddenly sneered.

"There is no difference at all between us and the unlucky guy who died in the spider nest."

"Typical Lingzhi. Obviously his sanity has reached the bottom, and he knows that there is still such a long way to the shelter, but the moment he saw the purple plant, all that was left in his mind was greed... For a few resources, he almost gave up his life in the wild."

Fang Yun curled up her legs with lingering fear and gently rested her chin on her knees. The firelight reflected the paleness of her cheeks.

"The sanity value dropped below the bottom line...it turns out to be this fear that even the soul will be completely drained."

The tension in the room was finally relieved bit by bit.

There was a soft rustling sound in the soil next to the workbench.

The mandrake that had been violently stuffed into the storage space was released.

This weird little thing was only two palms high. Its rough fleshy roots were like a pair of short human legs, and it was spinning anxiously around Xu Mo's muddy shoes.

There are three small green leaves on its head.

Xu Mo pushed away the little monster that was trying to bite his boots, reached out to bring up the data panel, and began to quickly count the gains of today's life and death.

Today we were cutting wildly on the outskirts of the forest and obtained a total of 32 units of wood and 10 units of stone.

Together with the 31 units left in the storage box from yesterday, we finally collected a considerable amount of resources.

Bird traps and birdcages must be arranged tomorrow.

He stood up, walked to Fang Yun, and sat on the floor half a body apart.
